Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly decomposed the task by including an unnecessary step to determine whether Sergio Pérez and Pedro Rodríguez shared a podium, which was not part of the original question. The original problem only asked for the identification of "another Mexican Formula One race car driver who has held the podium besides the Force India driver born in 1990." This misstep led to a prolonged and irrelevant search for overlapping podium finishes, which diverted resources and time away from directly answering the original question.
